title: IngestionJob
description: Payload the Ingestion lane pushes to the Parsing lane via the Celery task `parsing.process_config` (Redis broker). Owned by Ingestion — see services/ingestion/app/queue_producer.py. Update this file and notify the Parsing lane before changing the shape.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the uploaded file's raw contents. Used for dedup.

storage_path.description: MinIO object key for the raw file, e.g. raw-configs/<file_hash><ext>.

original_filename.description: Filename as supplied by the uploading client.

uploaded_by.description: Identity of the uploading user. Currently a hardcoded placeholder pending auth-context wiring from the Gateway's JWT through the upload proxy.

uploaded_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of when the job was enqueued.

chunks.description: The raw config split into logical blocks by app/chunker.py, in order. Currently a naive fixed-size line splitter (default 500 lines/block), not block-boundary-aware.

index.description: 0-based position of this block within the file.
